title: Week 20 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “land”?
options: Natural resources used in production.
An institution connecting savers, borrowers, investors, and payment users.
Law and enforcement intended to protect competitive processes from unlawful restraints or monopolization.
Government action preventing publication or expression before it occurs.
questions.explanation: Land means natural resources used in production.
choices: Natural resources used in production.
An institution connecting savers, borrowers, investors, and payment users.
Law and enforcement intended to protect competitive processes from unlawful restraints or monopolization.
Government action preventing publication or expression before it occurs.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “labor”?
options: The process by which issues gain or lose public and governmental attention.
The president’s constitutional role directing the armed forces.
The election in which voters choose among nominees and decide public offices or measures.
Human time, effort, skill, and knowledge used in production.
questions.explanation: Labor means human time, effort, skill, and knowledge used in production.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “capital”?
options: A rule concerning reserves relative to deposits; requirements have changed over time and may be set at zero.
The principle that political authority originates with the people.
A wage difference associated with job risk, conditions, location, or nonwage characteristics.
Produced tools, equipment, structures, and technology used to create other goods and services.
questions.explanation: Capital means produced tools, equipment, structures, and technology used to create other goods and services.
choices: A rule concerning reserves relative to deposits; requirements have changed over time and may be set at zero.

Ability to produce more output with the same resources.
questions.explanation: Absolute advantage means ability to produce more output with the same resources.

Employers’ willingness and ability to hire workers at different compensation levels.
questions.explanation: Comparative advantage means ability to produce at a lower opportunity cost.
